+package org.traccar.model;
+
+import java.util.Date;
+
+public record CompactPosition(long id, long deviceId, Date fixTime, double latitude, double longitude) {
+
+    public CompactPosition(Position position) {
+        this(position.getId(), position.getDeviceId(), position.getFixTime(),
+                position.getLatitude(), position.getLongitude());
+    }
+
+}
